## Validation

## Privacy and maintenance

- [ ] Identified the user data touched and verified tenant isolation.
- [ ] Audited disclosures and meaningful user-data changes.
- [ ] Preserved any required disclosure preview or confirmation.
- [ ] Identified third-party processing and checked consent.
- [ ] Preserved inspection, correction, revocation and deletion controls.
- [ ] Updated the relevant documentation and contracts.
- [ ] Ran the relevant verification commands from CONTRIBUTING.md.
